meta_description:
77K likes, 618 comments - financewithsharan on February 5, 2025: "It’s official!! We got SEBI-registered as a RIA (Registered Investment Advisor) last year, the holy grail license to give financial advice allowing us to currently manage ₹750 Crore+ in assets under Advisory.

The SEBI chairman recently stated that India needs 1 million RIAs to bridge the financial gap. Currently we have only 1,300. That’s like 1 for every 10 lakh people in India. Imagine having only one doctor per 10 lakh people! Scary right? 

This significant gap shows the urgent need for more qualified financial advisors to serve our diverse population. To have only 1,300 doctors in India would be a national crisis and yet when it comes to financial advice which directly impacts the hard earned money saved by people, their investments and future, we are completely unprepared.

I started this journey 4 years back by first creating content on financial planning. Two years later I started teaching financial planning through live sessions and taught over 5 lakh students. Now it’s time to finally walk the talk and actually manage public’s money with a team of 45+ people. 

To all my 70 lakh followers across social media, I’m deeply grateful for the unwavering support. Without this community’s trust I wouldn’t be able to write this post today. 

Thank you for being an integral part of this journey as I keep exploring new possibilities for our country.

#financewithsharan

[finance with sharan, SEBI, RIA, investment advice, financial planning]".
